# Esther Pujol Wilkie & Associates

> Independent property law practice in Sotogrande (Cádiz, Spain), led by Esther Pujol Andrés, practising as Esther Pujol Wilkie: abogada ejerciente, Ilustre Colegio Provincial de Abogados de Cádiz, n.º 1432 (admitted 1990). Advises foreign buyers, sellers and owners of property in Spain, in English and Spanish. Based on this coast since 1988, practising under her own name since 2012, previously in the United Kingdom and with the Spanish legal team of Hassans in Gibraltar.

Office: Guadalmarina 1, Portal 3, 2E, La Marina de Sotogrande, 11310 San Roque, Cádiz, Spain. Telephone +34 620 86 80 12. Email esther@pujolwilkie.com. Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00.

Areas served: mainly Sotogrande and the Campo de Gibraltar, also the Costa del Sol including Marbella and Estepona, and Gibraltar. Much of the work is done remotely under power of attorney for clients who live abroad.

The site is bilingual. English pages are at the root; each has a Spanish equivalent under /es/.

## Services (English)

- [Buying property in Spain](https://pujolwilkie.com/buying-property/): NIE, checks on title, debts and planning, reservation and contrato de arras, completion before the notary
- [Selling property in Spain](https://pujolwilkie.com/selling-property/): non-resident withholding, capital gains, plusvalía municipal
- [Property law](https://pujolwilkie.com/property-law/): how Spanish property law differs from the UK and Irish systems
- [Residency and visas](https://pujolwilkie.com/residency-and-visas/): non-lucrative residence, digital nomad visa, self-employment and family routes
- [Spanish Golden Visa](https://pujolwilkie.com/spanish-golden-visa/): closed to new applications since 3 April 2025; position of existing holders
- [Beckham Law](https://pujolwilkie.com/beckhams-law/): Spain's special tax regime for people moving to Spain
- [Tax and accountancy](https://pujolwilkie.com/tax-and-accountancy/): non-resident returns, ITP, annual obligations of owners
- [Immigration procedures](https://pujolwilkie.com/immigration-and-foreigners-legal-procedures/): NIE, TIE, residence authorisations, Withdrawal Agreement for UK nationals
- [Gibraltar and Spain](https://pujolwilkie.com/gibraltar-and-spain/): cross-border residence, tax and property
- [Boats and moorings](https://pujolwilkie.com/boats-and-moorings/): buying and selling boats and moorings in Spain
- [Property management](https://pujolwilkie.com/property-management-services/): care of the property while the owner is away
- [Full client service](https://pujolwilkie.com/full-client-service/): everything handled by one practice over the years

The pages give general information on Spanish law and are not legal advice; every case is assessed individually. The firm does not publish fees.
